core_obligations: Transfer the stack-in-groupoids condition along the equivalence.
Local nonemptiness: a covering making (S_1)_{U_i} nonempty maps through F to one making (S_2)_{U_i} nonempty.
Local transitivity: cover U so that G(x)|_{U_i} and G(y)|_{U_i} are isomorphic in S_1, then transfer the isomorphism back through the fibrewise equivalence.
Reverse direction: apply the proven direction to the equivalence G : S_2 -> S_1 with the roles of the two categories exchanged.
proof_roadmap: Verify the two gerbe conditions (local nonemptiness, local transitivity of isomorphisms) transfer along the equivalence, then obtain the converse by symmetry of the data.
difficulty_reason: Two condition transfers, each an application of the equivalence on fibres, plus a symmetric converse; no construction.
